entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a technical fault. It's broken. The main reason I bought it, the pulse tracking, is completely defective.
Okay, thank you for clarifying. Can you tell me a bit more about what's happening? You mentioned the pulse tracking is defective?
Yes. It's just not working correctly. The readings are all over the place, and it won't sync the data properly to the app. I just want to return it.
I understand your frustration. Let me just pull up your account details. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered to you 33 days ago, on December 26th.
Right. So are you going to take it back or not?

Let me just check our policy for you. Please hold. ... Okay, I've checked. Since the item is defective and you're unfortunately outside our 10-day return period, I can absolutely process a return for a full refund for you.
Fine. So you'll send me a shipping label?

Yes, absolutely. I'm processing that for you now. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box with the VeloBand inside, and drop it off at any post office.
Whatever. How long until I get my money back?
Once our warehouse receives the return, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days. Is there anything else I can help with?
No. Just make sure the email actually shows up.
It has been sent. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
